name: M&G
recent: Marine & General 于2026年10月22日召开股东大会，所有议案均获通过；同期完成 JMM PS 换股，发行2500万新股于10月14日上市。公司2026财年首季（截至7月31日）净利650万令吉，营收同比下滑19.3%。近期多名董事及大股东在公开市场减持或增持股份。
notable: 股东大会于2026年10月22日举行，所有议案获通过，包括重选四名董事及批准董事酬金。
因 JMM PS 换股，公司以每股 RM0.10 发行2500万新股，并于2026年10月14日上市。
执行董事 Abdul Rahman bin Ali 于2026年10月20日增持1,155,000股。
risks: 非执行董事 Nik Abdul Malik bin Nik Mohd Amin 于2026年10月5日至7日合计减持2,339,000股。
主席兼执行董事 Tan Sri Mohammed Azlan bin Hashim 于2026年9月30日至10月2日合计减持8,416,500股（视为权益）。
earnings: 2026财年首季（截至2026年7月31日）营收为75,594,000令吉，同比下滑19.3%，环比增长13.3%；净利为6,518,000令吉，同比下滑62.1%，净利率8.6%，上一季度净利率为-9.2%。

recent_en: Marine & General held its AGM on 22 Oct 2026 with all resolutions passed, and completed the JMM PS share exchange with 25 million new shares listed on 14 Oct 2026. 1QFY2026 (ended 31 Jul 2026) net profit was RM6.5 million with revenue down 19.3% YoY. Several directors and a substantial shareholder recently disposed of or acquired shares in the open market.
notable_en: AGM held on 22 Oct 2026 with all resolutions passed, including re-election of four directors and approval of directors' remuneration.
25 million new shares issued at RM0.10 each upon exchange of JMM PS, listed on 14 Oct 2026.
Executive Director Abdul Rahman bin Ali acquired 1,155,000 shares on 20 Oct 2026.
risks_en: Non-Executive Director Nik Abdul Malik bin Nik Mohd Amin disposed a total of 2,339,000 shares between 5 and 7 Oct 2026.
Chairman & Executive Director Tan Sri Mohammed Azlan bin Hashim disposed a total of 8,416,500 shares (deemed interest) between 30 Sep and 2 Oct 2026.
earnings_en: 1QFY2026 (ended 31 Jul 2026) revenue was RM75,594,000, down 19.3% YoY but up 13.3% QoQ; net profit was RM6,518,000, down 62.1% YoY, with net margin at 8.6% versus -9.2% in the prior quarter.
